findings.issue: The weak acid–strong base equivalence-point row incorrectly says “Acidic.” It should say “Basic”: at equivalence, A⁻ reacts with water to form HA and OH⁻.
findings.evidence: SOURCE 8.5, “pH at the equivalence point by titration type,” labels weak acid–strong base “Basic; conjugate base of the weak acid reacts with water.” The CED 8.5 excerpt likewise states that weak-acid titrations are basic at equivalence.
